kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننقرئ (form VII)
# نَنْقَرِئُ (nanqariʔu) /nan.qa.ri.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْقَرَأَ (inqaraʔa)
# نَنْقَرِئَ (nanqariʔa) /nan.qa.ri.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْقَرَأَ (inqaraʔa)
# نَنْقَرِئْ (nanqariʔ) /nan.qa.riʔ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْقَرَأَ (inqaraʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
